summary: Mode-based dispatch on the mode selector at this+0x1C. For modes 0-5, integrates physics state into the position fields (this+0xC) and sets the activity flag byte at this+0xA to 1. For mode 6, accumulates vehicle telemetry, then copies a 3-dword position triplet from the sub-object at this+0x20 (offset 0x34D4) into the position fields this+0xC/0x10/0x14. Any other mode returns immediately. Returns the last computed result.
